messages.en:
{07 15 00}I got a bone to pick with
you!{01 00 00 05 00} You always open 
letters that aren't yours?!
{07 01 00}Don't lie!{01 00 00 14 00} Do you think I'm
stupid or something.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}?!

{07 15 00}Listen up, and listen good!{01 00 00 14 00}
If you do it again, you and
me are done, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 05 00}Come on!{01 00 00 0f 00} Gimme back my
letter now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Mul on sinuga kana kitkuda!
{01 00 00 05 00}Kas sa avad alati
võõraid kirju?!
{07 01 00}Ära valeta!{01 00 00 14 00} Kas ma olen
sinu arust loll{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.?!

{07 15 00}Kuula ja kuula hoolega!{01 00 00 14 00}
Kui sa seda veel teed, on
meie vahel lõpp, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 05 00}Ole nüüd!{01 00 00 0f 00} Anna mu kiri
kohe tagasi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 02 00}What're you trying to pull,
eh? You think I'm some kind
of idiot, is that it?
{07 16 00}How many times did I tell
ya not to open that letter
to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
And you went ahead and did
it anyway. Way to go,
chief! You're a moron!
{07 15 00}Give it back now...{01 01 00}
You're a disgrace,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Mida sa üritad teha,
mis? Kas sa pead mind
mingiks idioodiks või?
{07 16 00}Mitu korda ma ütlesin,
et sa ei avaks seda kirja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}le?
Ja sa läksid ja tegid seda
ikka. Tubli töö,
pealik! Sa oled tobu!
{07 15 00}Anna kohe tagasi...{01 01 00}
Sa oled häbiplekk,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hey!{01 00 00 05 00} Do you usually go
around opening up people's
mail? Is that it?
{07 00 00}Well, that garbage doesn't 
fly with me! You're like 32
flavors of stupid!
{07 01 00}Hand that letter over now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hei!{01 00 00 05 00} Kas sa käid
tavaliselt teiste kirju
avamas? Kas nii?
{07 00 00}Noh, see rämps ei lähe
minu juures läbi! Sa oled
32 maitsega rumalus!
{07 01 00}Anna see kiri kohe siia,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
